title: Absolute signed two-tail expectation
statement: Let $t\geq0$ and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. For a uniformly random sign vector $X\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define $R(X)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$ and $U_t(X)=\mathbf{1}_{\{t<R(X)\}}$. Then $\mathbb{E}|U_t(X)-U_t(-X)|=2\mathbb{E}U_t(X)$.
